planets.name: K2-55 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-55 with a 2.85-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-55 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-55. Its orbit and size follow Howard et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
